title: Marriage and Divorce: What God Wants and the Hope He Gives
speaker: Aaron Brockett
leader_notes: Heads-up: Topic may be raw for those who've experienced divorce.
Remind groups to stick to discussion time limits.
opener: What's one promise you made years ago that's harder to keep now?
context: Jesus was teaching in Judea when Pharisees asked Him a tricky question about divorce, trying to trap Him.
read_aloud: Read Mark 10. Note Jesus' response to the Pharisees' question about divorce.
observation: What was Jesus' main point about marriage when the Pharisees questioned Him?

discuss.heading: Marriage's True Purpose
discuss.question: When have you seen the 'one flesh' concept of marriage described here in real life?
probes: How does it challenge how you view marriage?

discuss.heading: Navigating Brokenness
discuss.question: Where have you experienced or seen the painful side of divorce?
probes: What long-term impacts are still felt?
How did you see God bring healing, if at all?

discuss.heading: Grace Beyond Failure
discuss.question: When did you experience grace after a mistake or failure in any area?
probes: How did it change your relationships?

obstacle: What is the honest reason you might avoid the hard conversations in your relationship?
commit: Name one small step you will take this week toward reconciliation or growth in your relationships.
carry: Next week, ask each other: 'What happened when you took that step towards reconciliation or growth?'
